source_of_truth: Repository search and selected prior artifacts after Gemini Red Team review
purpose: Prevent re-inventing existing Tokenoskobi mechanisms before modifying the News Intelligence roadmap.

fast_heavy_path_and_priority_queue.relevance: Already covers lazy evaluation, fast path isolation, heavy path queue budget, overflow policy, duplicate collapse, borderline rate limiting and priority classes. Do not create a new separate queue system for News.

complexity_budget_and_continuous_evoluti.relevance: Already covers benefit-cost scoring, latency/cpu/ram/complexity/failure risk/evidence cost/rollback cost, and change-tier evidence requirements. News roadmap changes must use this rather than inventing a new economy metric.

opportunity_cost_and_false_negative_guar.relevance: Already treats missed opportunity/false negative as first-class risk while forbidding trade authority and hot-path bloat. News should route low-confidence/high-potential items into this discipline, not create a parallel opportunity system.

unknown_anomaly_engine.relevance: Already asks why behavior does not look normal and names News Intelligence as a producer. News adversarial fixtures should feed or validate this boundary rather than duplicate the Unknown Anomaly engine.

threat_memory_and_outcome_intelligence.relevance: Already defines threat/outcome/false positive/false negative/missed opportunity memory and hot-path readmodel-only rule. News outcomes should reuse this pattern.

data_provenance_and_canonicalization.relevance: Already defines RAW/STAGING/VALIDATED/CANONICAL/QUARANTINE/EVIDENCE_SIDECAR, source reliability, confidence, raw hash, no silent overwrite, and quarantine lifecycle. News source reliability and semantic contamination should align with this contract.

lazy_gap_analysis.news_delta_needed: Define News-specific trigger thresholds for Gap Analysis, using fast path for high-confidence matches and heavy/review path for ambiguous matches.

single_review_queue_with_lanes.map_to_existing: V2_47B priority classes and queue budget
single_review_queue_with_lanes.news_delta_needed: Use existing queue model with logical NEWS/GAP/ADVERSARIAL lanes, not a separate physical queue.

opportunity_cost_of_silence.map_to_existing: V2_48B missed opportunity feedback and ERA24 opportunity cost baseline
opportunity_cost_of_silence.news_delta_needed: Map low-confidence high-narrative-potential news to context-only observe/review states; do not discard and do not authorize trade.

adversarial_fixtures.map_to_existing: Unknown Anomaly, Threat Memory, Data Provenance
adversarial_fixtures.news_delta_needed: Create parametric news adversarial fixture set, not a new adversarial engine.

source_reliability_scoring.news_delta_needed: News readmodel must expose source reliability class and evidence state, not create separate scoring authority.

semantic_contamination_guard.map_to_existing: ERA33 contamination auditor discipline and PHASE28B raw/staging/validated/canonical separation
semantic_contamination_guard.news_delta_needed: Add News-specific narrative/evidence namespace separation and panel folded narrative rule later.

output_divergence_detection.map_to_existing: No direct prior artifact confirmed in this audit
output_divergence_detection.news_delta_needed: Add to later shadow validation, not ERA38 first fixture pass.

narrative_identity_gap_analysis.map_to_existing: PHASE28B token_pair_mismatch_suspected / identity ambiguous quarantine and V2_47B heavy path
narrative_identity_gap_analysis.news_delta_needed: Implement as conditional heavy/review path, not always-on NLP loop.

correlation_id_provenance_sidecar.map_to_existing: PHASE28B EVIDENCE_SIDECAR and RAW/STAGING lineage rules
correlation_id_provenance_sidecar.news_delta_needed: Keep staging compact with correlation_id only. Put provenance details in sidecar/map. No product-specific code and no staging bloat.

sidecar_safety_rules_added_after_red_tea.rule: A staging/context item must not be marked READY_FOR_FAST_PATH unless its correlation_id has a confirmed sidecar/provenance-map entry or an explicit NO_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED state.
sidecar_safety_rules_added_after_red_tea.ttl_rule: Provenance map keeps only active/pending correlation details. Completed/canonicalized/expired details move to archive/evidence sidecar according to lifecycle policy.
forbidden: Do not embed heavy provenance metadata inside staging objects.
Do not allow fast path ready state before correlation provenance write is confirmed.
Do not keep all historical provenance in active registry forever.
Do not add product-specific code for News-only provenance.

Do not create a new Opportunity Cost engine.
Do not create a new Complexity Budget engine.

Do not run Gap Analysis on every news item.
Do not embed heavy provenance metadata in staging objects.
